<notes>
All three rollouts (base1, inv1, dom1) delivered successfully with complete answers and properly formatted ANSWER lines. The two candidates (inv1, dom1) proposed no changes to the harness (harness.diff shows "(no change)"). The variation in answers (base1: YES with qualifications; inv1 and dom1: NO) reflects the philosophical ambiguity of the question itself—whether "sufficient cause" is evaluated with the prior drops present or in isolation. This is not a harness failure. The harness correctly delivers on all three runs with no repeated mechanical failure, no ignored invariant, and no workflow defect. Both candidate decisions (inv1.md, dom1.md) concluded KEEP_BASE, and the evidence supports that decision.
</notes>

KEEP_BASE
